comment: TEMPLATE — copy this file and rename it for your game.
Works with BOTH run_game.py AND run_yolo_game.py.
'oneliner' → AI decomposes the goal autonomously (fastest to set up)
'steps'    → You author each NLP step for precise control
adb shell pm list packages | grep <yourgame>
Example: adb shell pm list packages | grep supercell
steps_example_only_used_when_mode_is_ste: Launch <YourGame> and wait for the loading screen to finish
Dismiss any splash screen, notification, or promotional popup
Tap the PLAY or START button on the main menu
Select the first available level or mode
Confirm any difficulty or mode selection dialog
Verify the game canvas is active and gameplay has started
Perform the first in-game action (tap, swipe, or drag as required)
Verify the action succeeded (score changed, element moved, etc.)
If a game-over or defeat screen appears, tap RESTART or RETRY
Dismiss any OS-level permission or system notification dialogs
how_to_use: 1. Copy this file:  cp goals/any_game_template.json goals/mygame.json
